name: Aakash Dahal
bio: Developer tools and interactive physics software.

why.title: Why the statue
why.body: It’s Hermes. On the day he was born he stole fifty of Apollo’s cattle and walked them backwards so the tracks pointed the wrong way. Agents pull the same trick with their logs. I build the trackers. Robots are next and I expect they’ll try it too.

ringLine: I stole Apollo’s cattle on day one. Your agent won’t sneak one past me
